1. If I say I’m okay but you get a vibe that im not and I continue denying it, im definitely not okay and i probably wanna tell you without seeming like a burden so keep asking.
2. If i give one worded replies or show less interest or resort to “ok”, you fucked up, bad. Fix it before i raise hell.
3. If i use “wow.” with nothing else, you did smth that i didn’t like but the heights of it amused me so you’ve got about 5 minutes before my imagination runs wild and convinces me you’re an asshole not worth my time.
4. If i say I’ve got smth going on but i downplay it, it is actually smth major but i think you’ll think it’s stupid so keep asking or just be sweet enough till i start talking.
5. If I’m bored and don’t talk a lot, that’s cue for you to take lead, talk about things i like or just do smth I’ll like to bring me back.
6. If i ever bring up another girl wrt you, it is because I’m insecure and teasing/making jokes is my way of seeing whether you’re with me for real or just till the next prettier girl walks by.
7. If we ever fight, never yell/scream/raise your voice. You do that and i lose my patience fast enough to cut you off. Stay calm and hear me out cause if we’re fighting, im probably 5 mins from breaking down and crying. And also, loud voices scare me, especially from men.
8. If i ever look at you for longer than usual or stare, it’s cue to hug me or hold my hand or just physically come closer cause i want you to do it yourself without me having to ask.
9. If i say i dont wanna talk to you, i do not mean that one bit. I’m just exhausted and need you to take care of me and be patient.
10. If i am mad/annoyed/upset/disappointed, the quick fix is food, the more concrete long term fix is hugging me first and then reasoning out with me.
11. If i ever come in close to you, or lean into whatever direction you are in, reciprocate by coming close too. I’m either feeling cold, a lot of love for you or just want support.
12. ⁠If i ever keep asking you to tell me smth especially in context to me, it is because i am terribly unsure of myself and so, hearing you actually like me for a number of reasons mutes all the voices in my head saying otherwise.
13. If i send you this list, good luck buddy, i hate you enough to wanna have you around for a pretty long time.
